A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.name: reborn-p8-exploration-pilot
experiment.prespecified:
Classes-18, normal world, 100,000 exact engine turns. Gate on 54 complete
cells (18 paired birth tuples), one binary, GCC right-to-left order, zero
configuration errors, and the intended resolved flags in each class:
shipped 1/1, bfs0 0/1, nomixed 1/0. Check all abnormal outcomes before
advancing. The shipped borg.txt SHA-256 is
c225c1802c2a8ea6f662a8b6ea9a98826fd1f8ef4ff90f6b4841bae486ca6bdd.
Keep the shipped settings, world, compiler and birth tuples paired.
If the gate passes, read the first 900 classes-1800 starts through the
small, medium and big gates, pairing each single override against shipped.
Safety: all deaths and deaths at CL <= 2, rescued/newly killed, cause,
CL/DL at death, and unfinished outcomes with reasons. Primary progress
(#758): first attainment of CL5 or higher by 100,000 turns inclusive.
Include attainment before death or interruption. An unfinished start
with no verified attainment has unknown progress. Report coverage and
count paired effects on identifiable pairs. Report alive at cap with CL5
separately. DL3/DL5 arrivals and arrival turns, CL at 25k/50k/100k and
CL/DL exposure are secondary. Report overall, by class and by tier.
Reused starts are descriptive. Confirm a selected
default on unopened starts. Consider a both-off arm only if the single
overrides leave a concrete interaction. The P8 release comparison is #756.
experiment.question: Does turning breadth-first or mixed exploration off individually improve P8 progress without increasing early deaths?
